text: Thrown into fire. Your four words?
They lit a great fire, and said: Burn him.
As they threw him, Prophet Ibrahim, alayhis salaam, said: حَسْبُنَا اللّٰهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيْلُ. Allah is enough for us.
And Allah said: O fire, be coolness and safety upon Ibrahim.
When you're afraid today, say his words: حَسْبُنَا اللّٰهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيْلُ. Send this to someone who needs it.
